title: Samsung 100" M90H Mini LED 4K Smart TV (2026) $2,730.40 + Delivery ($0 within 30km of Store) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Samsung 100" M90H Mini LED 4K Smart TV (2026) $2,730.40 + Delivery ($0 within 30km of Store) @ The Good Guys

[RogueWolf] $2820 see if you can match that & then apply code
[lzhan1] " Code cannot be used in conjunction with any available Price Beat online."
[ClioB] TCL is suing Samsung over their M series TVs claiming to be Mini-LED which, they are not. Or, at least not in the same sense that TCL and other manufacturerers have in mind for the term. To put in other words, the local dimming on this TV is crap in comparison with those with full-array LEDs.
Do your own research.
[p3r514n] Exactly this. Avoid M series like plague.
[Metre] Some people sees the price and size, there goes the sale
[Make it so] I it the "Mini-LED" in the title needs to be in quotes, for that reason.
[plmko] IMO that's just TCL retaliating because Samsung sued them for loosely interpreting "QLED" and selling the TVs without quantum dot technology.
I wouldn't think much of this.
[noise36] Good price but tcl are the best bang for buck in this soace
[O15] A lot of people cannot comprehend any specifications beyond the screen size.
[team teri] A lot of people trust brand names. The reverse is true as well, I'm avoiding Samsung when possible, after a couple of sub-standard experiences.
[Snz] Poor eyesight would be an obvious reason.
[LikezDaBargainz] He's not actually, the codes are targeted per the heading, or you can get one by going to the website and following the prompts for signing up to storcash
[hasher22] 100" is crazy, I currently have 55" and I think that's too big for me haha
[team teri] Guess it depends what you use it for. Recently upgraded from 75 to 85 and not sure that was the right call to make, 98 would probably have been the better choice.
[lonewolf] what are you using the 55" for that you think its too big? as a monitor? I have a LG OLED 77 in my bedroom and i find it small, 100 " is perfect for living room / home theatre room (if not still a bit small)
[BeauKilla] Yeah, I just got my 65 tcl upgrading from a 50. I sit 3m away from it and couldn't imagine an 85 let alone a 100
[bigbadboogieman] Buyer beware with Samsung aftersales support.
[Swing] My experience with Samsung aftersales support is pretty simple: there doesn’t seem to be much "Samsung” in the after-sales support.
Repairs are outsourced to local third parties, and warranty claims seem to involve searching for any possible reason to deny coverage.
[bigbadboogieman] The local third parties simply reply we are waiting on Samsung to respond while Samsung does not respond until you threaten the retailer with fair trade/legal action. Then Samsung responds to the third party repairer with instructions to find any and all reasons to decline repair. I have basically written off Samsung from my life personally and waiting for whatever Samsung products currently in my life to gradually get replaced with alternatives.
[AdelaideDeals] Woolley Appliance Services Is their repairer bunch of xxxxxx. One technician came to assess monitor, I shown him video in person and sent to Samsung still they tools 1 month to resolve the issue. On top of that, I had soundbar which is never worked with voice assistant and keep disconnected from wifi (common issues) they replaced the wifi card, updated firmware etc. at the end, the made that soundbar completely brick as now not connecting with woofer on wireless. No Support from Samsung. NO MORE SAMSUNG PRODUCT.
[moorey] Got this from the last sales for around the same price. It’s not the best but arguably it beats projector
